title: The Quiet Club Picnic
question: 把今天“离开公众视线 -> 提前做预防措施 -> 伪装太成功 -> 看见公共规则 -> 身份不能取消规则”的表达，放进 school drama club picnic 场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: After the school play, I wanted to stay out of the limelight. I took precautions so that no one would recognize me at the park. My disguise was too perfect, so even a park worker did not believe I was the lead actor. There was a notice that said the picnic lawn was closed, and the rule still applies to me.
word_bank: so that no one would recognize me
